### Other

- [Block Frontmatter](https://sli.dev/features/block-frontmatter.md): Use a YAML code block as the frontmatter.
- [Bundle Remote Assets](https://sli.dev/features/bundle-remote-assets.md): Download and bundle remote assets when building your slides.
- [Click Markers](https://sli.dev/features/click-marker.md): Highlighting notes and auto-scrolling to the active section of notes.
- [Code Groups](https://sli.dev/features/code-groups.md): Group multiple code blocks and automatically match icon by the title name.
- [Comark Syntax](https://sli.dev/features/comark.md): A powerful syntax to enhance your markdown content with components and styles.
- [Draggable Elements](https://sli.dev/features/draggable.md): Move, resize, and rotate elements by dragging them with the mouse.
- [Drawing & Annotations](https://sli.dev/features/drawing.md): Draw and annotate your slides with ease.
- [Eject Theme](https://sli.dev/features/eject-theme.md): Eject the installed theme from your project to customize it.
- [Features](https://sli.dev/features.md)
- [Frontmatter Merging](https://sli.dev/features/frontmatter-merging.md): Merge frontmatter from multiple markdown files.
- [Generate PDF when Building](https://sli.dev/features/build-with-pdf.md): Generate a downloadable PDF along with your slides build.
- [Global Layers](https://sli.dev/features/global-layers.md): Create custom components that persist across slides.
- [Icons](https://sli.dev/features/icons.md): Use icons from virtually all open-source icon sets directly in your markdown.
- [Import Code Snippets](https://sli.dev/features/import-snippet.md): Import code snippets from existing files into your slides.
- [Importing Slides](https://sli.dev/features/importing-slides.md): Split your `slides.md` into multiple files for better reusability and organization.
- [Integrated Editor](https://sli.dev/features/side-editor.md): Edit your slides source file alongside the presentation.
- [LaTeX](https://sli.dev/features/latex.md): Slidev comes with LaTeX support out-of-box, powered by KaTeX.
- [Line Highlighting](https://sli.dev/features/line-highlighting.md): Highlight specific lines in code blocks based on clicks.
- [Line Numbers](https://sli.dev/features/code-block-line-numbers.md): Enable line numbering for all code blocks across the slides or individually.
- [Max Height](https://sli.dev/features/code-block-max-height.md): Set a maximum height for a code block and enable scrolling.
- [Mermaid Diagrams](https://sli.dev/features/mermaid.md): Create diagrams/graphs from textual descriptions, powered by Mermaid.
- [Monaco Editor](https://sli.dev/features/monaco-editor.md): Turn code blocks into fully-featured editors, or generate a diff between two code blocks.
- [Monaco Runner](https://sli.dev/features/monaco-run.md): Run code directly in the editor and see the result.
- [Navigation Direction Variants](https://sli.dev/features/direction-variant.md): Apply different styles and animations based on the navigation direction.
- [Notes Auto Ruby](https://sli.dev/features/notes-auto-ruby.md): Automatically add `<ruby>` tags to your notes.
- [Open Graph Image](https://sli.dev/features/og-image.md): Set the Open Graph image for your slides.
- [PlantUML Diagrams](https://sli.dev/features/plantuml.md): Create diagrams from textual descriptions, powered by PlantUML.
- [Presenter Timer](https://sli.dev/features/timer.md): Timer for the presenter mode.
- [Prettier Plugin](https://sli.dev/features/prettier-plugin.md): Use the Prettier plugin to format your slides.
- [Recording](https://sli.dev/features/recording.md): Record your presentation with the built-in camera view and recording feature.
- [Remote Access](https://sli.dev/features/remote-access.md): Access your presentation remotely with Slidev's remote access feature.
- [Rough Markers](https://sli.dev/features/rough-marker.md): Integrate Rough Notation to allow marking or highlighting elements in your slides.
- [SEO Meta Tags](https://sli.dev/features/seo-meta.md): Configure SEO meta tags for better social media sharing and search engine optimization.
- [Shiki Magic Move](https://sli.dev/features/shiki-magic-move.md): Enable granular transition between code changes, similar to Keynote's Magic Move.
- [Slide Canvas Size](https://sli.dev/features/canvas-size.md): Set the size for all your slides.
- [Slide Hooks](https://sli.dev/features/slide-hook.md): Hooks to manage the slide lifecycle.
- [Slide Scope Styles](https://sli.dev/features/slide-scope-style.md): Define styles for only the current slide.
- [Slot Sugar for Layouts](https://sli.dev/features/slot-sugar.md): A syntax sugar for named slots in layouts.
- [The `Transform` Component](https://sli.dev/features/transform-component.md): A component for scaling some elements.
- [TwoSlash Integration](https://sli.dev/features/twoslash.md): A powerful tool for rendering TypeScript code blocks with type information on hover or inlined.
- [VS Code Extension](https://sli.dev/features/vscode-extension.md): Help you better organize your slides and have a quick overview of them.
- [Writable Monaco Editor](https://sli.dev/features/monaco-write.md): A monaco editor that allows you to write code directly in the slides and save the changes back to the file.
- [Zoom Slides](https://sli.dev/features/zoom-slide.md): Zoom the content of a slide to a specific scale.
